Committee: Governmental Affairs
Sponsor: Orr
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 02/24/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 211 as introduced will not affect state or local funding.
As substituted and reported by the Committee on Governmental Affairs would increase receipts deposited into the Public Safety Fund of the Alabama Law Enforcement Agency by a small undetermined amount from registration fees currently collected for all-terrain and off-highway vehicles that are currently required to be deposited into an off-road vehicle account in the State Treasury and used for the acquisition of off-road trail and use areas, and to fund a grant in-aid program to counties and municipalities for the same.
Jimmy Holley, Chairperson
Governmental Affairs

Committee: Transportation, Utilities and Infrastructure
Sponsor: Orr
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 03/12/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 211 as passed the Senate provides that all-terrain and off-highway vehicle registration fees currently required to be deposited into an off-road vehicle account in the State Treasury for certain uses would now be deposited into the Public Safety Fund of the Alabama Law Enforcement Agency (ALEA). According to ALEA, approximately $250 in registration fees have been deposited for Fiscal Year 2021 year-to-date.
Lynn Greer, Chair
Transportation, Utilities and Infrastructure
